fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (NTM EPS at Sep-2027 ~$4.60 x 19x = $87), FCF yield (~$4.20/share FCF at 4.5% = $93) and EV/EBITDA (~$3.4B EBITDA x 15x less ~$3.8B net debt over ~575M diluted shares = $82); weights 0.5/0.25/0.25 give ~$87.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: NTM non-GAAP EPS as of Sep-2027 ~$4.60 (FY27 consensus ~$3.65; Q2 FY27 guide $0.93/qtr = $3.72 run-rate; FY28 ~$4.3-4.6 on ~$7.2-7.6B revenue, ~41% op margin, ~$190M interest, ~13% tax, ~575M diluted shares incl. 23.8M from mandatory convertible preferred) x 19x (mid-cycle analog multiple; MCHP fwd P/E now ~20x, TXN ~28x, ADI ~26x, ON ~19x)

methods.name: FCF yield
methods.inputs: FY28 FCF ~$2.4B (EBITDA ~$3.4B less ~$150M capex, ~$300M cash tax, ~$200M interest, working capital build) / 575M shares = ~$4.20/share, capitalized at 4.5% yield

methods.name: EV/EBITDA
methods.inputs: Forward EBITDA ~$3.4B x 15x = $51B EV, less ~$3.8B projected net debt at Sep-2027 (from $5.2B, deleveraging ~$350-400M/qtr, no buybacks), = ~$47.2B / 575M shares

bear.story: Recovery proves to be restocking plus supply-constraint double ordering; bookings roll over in H1 CY2027, gross margin falls back toward 60% as licensing/reserve benefits fade and foundry/OSAT costs rise; NTM EPS ~$3.40 and multiple compresses to ~14-15x amid a broader semi derating and higher yields.

base.story: Revenue grows to ~$1.8-1.9B/qtr by mid-2027 as industrial, A&D and data center (~$1B CY26, PCIe Gen6 ramps) continue; GM holds ~65% model, op margin ~40%+; net debt falls under 2x EBITDA; NTM EPS ~$4.60 at ~19x.

bull.story: Supply constraints ease and unfulfilled orders ship; full cyclical upswing toward prior FY23 peak revenue (~$8B+ run-rate) with 44%+ op margins, NTM EPS ~$5.40, and the market pays ~22-23x as in the May-2026 peak (stock hit $105.91 on far lower earnings).

thesis_break_reason: At ~$55 the stock would be ~12x the $4.6 forward EPS base case and back near the 2025 trough ($48.52 low); reaching it would most likely mean bookings/book-to-bill have turned below 1, gross margin guided back toward 60%, or channel inventory rebuilt, i.e. the cyclical recovery has failed rather than ordinary 50%-vol noise.

catalysts.event: Q2 FY27 results and December-quarter guide (mgmt flagged better-than-seasonal); watch GM normalization from 66-67%
Q3 FY27 results / March-quarter guide; bookings and lead times
Q4 FY27 results and first FY28 view; leverage below 2x could reopen buybacks/dividend growth
Q1 FY28 results close to horizon
Foundry/OSAT/substrate capacity squeeze from AI demand easing or tightening
Sector rate sensitivity, tariffs/trade restrictions, AI capex sentiment swings (e.g., July 2026 chip selloff)
Management succession: CEO Sanghi (interim-turned-CEO, 10b5-1 sales) and COO Simoncic departure Aug 2026
Hailo edge-AI integration and data center (PCIe Gen6, 12 design wins) ramps

key_uncertainties: Whether the 38-41% y/y recovery is end-demand or restocking/double ordering amplified by industry supply constraints
Gross margin durability after Q2 FY27 one-offs (licensing at 100% GM, distribution pricing reserve release)
Multiple the market will pay for cyclical analog in late 2027 (14x vs 22x drives most of the range)
Rate and AI-sentiment driven semiconductor sector swings
Leadership continuity and capital allocation (no buybacks until leverage falls)
reasoning: Fundamentals are clearly improving: Q1 FY27 (Jun-26) revenue $1.485B (+38% y/y, +13% q/q) beat guide, non-GAAP GM 63.8%, EPS $0.76 vs $0.67-0.71 guide; Q2 guide $1.589-1.618B, GM 66-67%, EPS $0.91-0.95; book-to-bill well above 1, distribution inventory at 25 days, orders going unfilled because of external foundry/OSAT constraints, and December quarter expected above seasonal. Yet the stock fell from $105.91 (May 8) to ~$78.69 on semi-sector derating (July AI selloff, rising yields), margin-peak worries (mgmt says 66-67% includes non-repeatable benefits, long-term model 65%), PT cuts (Citi 95, Wells 88, TD Cowen 90), and COO departure. At $78.69 it trades ~20x FY27 consensus $3.65 and ~17-18x my FY28 ~$4.5, cheaper than TXN/ADI. My blended fair value is ~$87 (P/E, FCF yield, EV/EBITDA), about 10% above spot, plus ~2.3% dividend. Analyst mean PT ~$100-108 (range $80-135) I treat as optimistic evidence only. Base rates: realized vol 50% and cyclical semis often move +/-40% in a year; I use a slightly narrower ~42% lognormal spread centered near $84 median (mean ~$87-88 given skew), with a modestly fattened left tail for cycle-rollover risk. Scenario mix 25/50/25 at $50/$88/$122 gives expected ~$87, consistent. P(>= spot $79) ~0.56 reflects positive drift from earnings growth tempered by peak-margin and cycle risk. Research used ~10 searches/fetches including the SEC 8-K exhibit; no option data consulted.
